sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: CONUS SUBSET OF LARGE-SCALE PATTERN WILL CONTINUE TO BE CHARACTERIZED BY WRN RIDGE AND ERN TROUGH...THOUGH LATTER IS BEING BREACHED BY STG SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW EVIDENT IN MOISTURE-CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER NRN ID/WRN MT. THIS PERTURBATION WILL PROCEED ESEWD THROUGH 00Z...REACHING CENTRAL MT...NWRN WY AND ERN ID. PERTURBATION THEN WILL ACCELERATE SEWD...REACHING SRN MT AND WY...WITH VORTICITY LOBE EXTENDING TO NEB PANHANDLE. THIS IS BASED ON STG CONSENSUS OF LATEST AVBL ECMWF/SPECTRAL AND NEARLY ALL SREF MEMBERS...AS OPPOSED TO FAST OUTLIER OF NAM. MEANWHILE...WELL-DEFINED MID/UPPER-LEVEL CYCLONE NOW OVER LM AND LOWER MI WILL PIVOT NEWD...CROSSING LH LATE AFTN THROUGH EVENING AND REACHING WRN QUE BY END OF PERIOD. DESPITE MOVEMENT OF THIS CYCLONE OUT OF MEAN-TROUGH POSITION...CYCLONIC FLOW ALOFT WILL EXTEND AS FAR S AS NRN GULF...AND COVER BROAD SWATH FROM NRN PLAINS TO TN VALLEY TO MID ATLC. AT SFC...FRONTAL-WAVE LOW WAS LOCATED AT 11Z OVER SRN LH...WITH COLD FRONT SWWD ACROSS SRN OH...WRN TN...AND SRN AR...THEN ARCHING WWD/NWWD OVER NW TX AND SRN CO. THIS COLD FRONT CURRENTLY IS PRECEDED BY AGGREGATE OF OUTFLOW/CONVECTIVE BOUNDARIES LOCATED OVER SW/CENTRAL/E TX...LA AND MS...AS WELL AS

sections.title: NC TO NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: PREFRONTAL TROUGH AND OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES WILL BE PRIMARY/INITIAL FOCI FOR TSTM GENESIS TODAY. AS AIR MASS NEAR THESE BOUNDARIES DIURNALLY DESTABILIZES...AMIDST WEAK CINH...GRADUAL DEVELOPMENT AND UPSCALE GROWTH OF SCATTERED SFC-BASED TSTMS IS FCST...WITH CORRESPONDING STEADY INCREASE IN SVR THREAT/COVERAGE INTO MID-LATE AFTN. FARTHER E...TSTM COVERAGE INITIALLY SHOULD BE ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED IN WARM SECTOR EWD TO ATLC COAST. SFC DEW POINTS GENERALLY MID-UPPER 60S F AND PATCHY AREAS OF STRONGER SFC HEATING WILL FOSTER MLCAPE RANGING FROM AROUND 2000 J/KG OVER INLAND AREAS OF TIDEWATER REGION TO 500 J/KG IN ERN NY AND NEW ENGLAND. AS OFTEN IS TRUE IN SUCH REGIMES...INSTABILITY DECREASES NWD WHILE SHEAR DECREASES SWD. STG MID-UPPER-LEVEL SPEED MAXIMA WILL PIVOT NEWD THROUGH SERN SEMICIRCLE OF GREAT LAKES CYCLONE...LEADING TO STRENGTHENING DEEP SHEAR OVER MUCH OF THIS REGION. EVENTUAL ORGANIZATION OF ONE OR TWO PRIMARY QLCS IS EXPECTED WITH DAMAGING WIND BEING MAIN CONCERN...AND ISOLATED SVR HAIL ALSO POSSIBLE WHILE CELLS STILL ARE RELATIVELY DISCRETE. A TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT WHERE MOST PROBABLE PARAMETER-SPACE JUXTAPOSITION OF CAPE AND SHEAR OCCURS...ACROSS ERN MID ATLC

sections.title: CENTRAL ROCKIES AND ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: TSTMS WILL DEVELOP TODAY...INITIALLY OVER HIGHER TERRAIN...THEN SPREAD/GROW SEWD ACROSS OUTLOOK AREA INTO DESTABILIZING AIR MASS CHARACTERIZED BY SFC DEW POINTS 40S TO LOWER 50S IN MOST PLAINS/FOOTHILLS ZONES. STRENGTHENING OF BOTH DEEP SHEAR AND LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ARE EXPECTED WITH APCH OF SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW OVER NRN ROCKIES. MLCAPE 1000-2000 J/KG AND 40-50 KT EFFECTIVE-SHEAR MAGNITUDES ARE EXPECTED OVER MUCH OF THIS CORRIDOR. LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE WILL BE MAXIMIZED AROUND SFC LOW AND ADJOINING LEE TROUGH/FRONTOGENETIC ZONE. NEAR-SFC WINDS WILL REMAIN BACKED TO E OF THAT BOUNDARY...MAXIMIZING LOW-LEVEL SHEAR AND STORM-RELATIVE INFLOW. THESE FACTORS SHOULD RESULT IN POTENTIAL FOR SUPERCELLS TO DEVELOP...OFFERING LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING GUSTS AND RISK OF A FEW TORNADOES. FCST SWD OR EVEN SSWWD STORM MOTIONS MAY KEEP SOME SUCH TSTMS IN MTNS...WHILE OTHER ACTIVITY MOVES OVER HIGH PLAINS FROM SERN WY TO ERN CO.

sections.title: SC TO SE TX
sections.text: EXPECT SCATTERED TO LOCALLY NUMEROUS TSTMS IN CLUSTERS AND BKN BANDS...DEVELOPING AMIDST DIFFERENTIAL-HEATING ZONES AND INVOF OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES...MAINLY AHEAD OF SFC FRONT. ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS MAY OCCUR WITH MOST INTENSE DOWNDRAFTS. ANY CLUSTERING OR GREATER LOCALIZED CONCENTRATIONS OF SVR RISK WITHIN THIS BROAD/MRGL-RISK CORRIDOR WILL DEPEND ON LOW-PREDICTABILITY MESOBETA-SCALE PROCESSES. GIVEN THAT HEATING AND COMMONNESS OF LOW-70S F SFC DEW POINTS...AREAS OF RELATIVELY MAXIMIZED INSOLATION DURATION WILL ATTAIN MLCAPE VALUES UP TO ABOUT 2000 J/KG...DESPITE WEAK LAPSE RATES ALOFT. WEAK DEEP SHEAR WILL LIMIT ORGANIZATION OF SVR THREAT. ..EDWARDS/ROGERS.. 07/15/2014

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING OVER CENTRAL AND EASTERN PARTS OF WYOMING AND COLORADO. OTHER SEVERE STORMS WITH PRIMARILY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ARE EXPECTED FROM NEW ENGLAND SOUTHWARD ACROSS THE MIDDLE ATLANTIC STATES AND THE CAROLINAS.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A DEEP MID-LEVEL CYCLONE CENTERED OVER LAKE HURON PER WATER VAPOR LOOPS WILL TRACK EWD INTO SRN ONTARIO BEFORE ADVANCING NWD AS IT PROGRESSES INTO WRN QUEBEC. A BROAD AREA OF CYCLONIC FLOW ALOFT WILL BE MAINTAINED OVER MUCH OF THE CNTRL/ERN CONUS...AS ONE EMBEDDED CYCLONE ADVANCES SEWD FROM THE NRN ROCKIES TO THE ADJACENT PLAINS...AND A MID-LEVEL SPEED MAX NOSES INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY AND WRN GREAT LAKES REGION. COLD ADVECTION RELATED TO THE SPEED MAX WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT AMPLIFICATION OF THE TROUGH ATTENDANT TO THE ERN CYCLONE...WHILE AN EXTENSIVE...SEASONABLY STRONG SFC COLD FRONT ADVANCES EWD/SWD ACROSS THE ERN/SERN CONUS. LEE SFC TROUGHING OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS WILL ENCOURAGE POLEWARD RETURN OF GULF/CONVECTIVELY RECYCLED MOISTURE OVER THE WRN PERIPHERY OF A CNTRL/NRN PLAINS ANTICYCLONE.

sections.title: NC TO NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: MORNING RAOBS SAMPLE RICH TROPOSPHERIC MOISTURE -- E.G. PW OF 1.7-1.9 INCHES -- AHEAD OF THE EXTENSIVE FRONT WITH POOR TROPOSPHERIC LAPSE RATES AND LITTLE CAPPING. STORMS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY AHEAD OF AND ALONG THE FRONT THROUGH THE DAY. A CORRIDOR OF 30-40 KT OF MID-LEVEL FLOW ACCOMPANYING A MID-LEVEL JET E OF THE TROUGH/CYCLONE WILL FAVORABLY SUPERIMPOSE 500-1500 J/KG OF PRE-FRONTAL MLCAPE TO SUPPORT SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS MULTICELL CLUSTERS/QUASI-LINEAR SEGMENTS. CONVECTIVE MOMENTUM TRANSPORT OF ENHANCED FLOW ALOFT...AND WATER LOADING...ARE EXPECTED TO SUPPORT ISOLATED TO SCATTERED DMGG WIND GUSTS. THE GREATEST CONCENTRATION OF SUCH ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED FROM NERN VA TO SWRN NEW ENGLAND...WHERE VIS IMAGERY AND SFC OBS IMPLY POCKETS OF INSOLATION-INDUCED SFC HEATING TO LOCALLY STEEPEN LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES IN CLOSEST PROXIMITY TO THE STRONGEST FLOW ALOFT. A TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT FROM FAR ERN PA AND CNTRL NJ NWD INTO WRN NEW ENGLAND WITH LINE-EMBEDDED MESO-VORTICES/TRANSIENT SUPERCELLS AND PERHAPS MARGINAL PRE-FRONTAL SEMI-DISCRETE SUPERCELLS...AIDED BY ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL SHEAR BENEATH AN H7 SPEED MAX.

sections.title: CENTRAL ROCKIES AND ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: OROGRAPHIC ASCENT ALONG WITH FORCING FOR ASCENT PRECEDING THE WRN MID-LEVEL CYCLONE WILL FOSTER INCREASING THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND IN PROXIMITY TO THE LEE TROUGH AS LAPSE RATES DIURNALLY STEEPEN. WITH STRENGTHENING MID/HIGH-LEVEL FLOW...LONG/STRAIGHT-LINE HODOGRAPHS SUGGEST AN INITIALLY DISCRETE/SEMI-DISCRETE SUPERCELL MODE THIS AFTERNOON...WITH SVR WIND/HAIL POSSIBLE. SOME TORNADO RISK MAY EVOLVE OVER THE HIGH PLAINS AS RELATIVELY BACKED SFC WINDS FACILITATE AN ELONGATED/LOOPING STRUCTURE TO THE LOW-LEVEL PORTION OF THE HODOGRAPH AMIDST MODESTLY RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE -- E.G. SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MIDDLE/UPPER 50S. HOWEVER...INCREASING CONVECTIVE COVERAGE AND RELATED CONGEALING COLD POOLS WILL LIKELY SUPPORT A TRANSITION TO SMALL...FORWARD-PROPAGATING CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS WITH DMGG WINDS/SVR HAIL INTO THE EVENING HOURS.

sections.title: SC TO SE TX
sections.text: SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS STORMS WILL OCCUR THROUGH THE AFTERNOON AS DIURNAL HEATING DRIVES AN INCREASE IN UNCAPPED BUOYANCY AMIDST ASCENT RELATED TO THE AFOREMENTIONED FRONT AND ANTECEDENT OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES. WATER LOADING ASSOCIATED WITH HIGH PW MAY SUPPORT SPORADIC DMGG WIND GUSTS...THOUGH WEAK FLOW THROUGH THE LOW/MID LEVELS WILL HAVE A TENDENCY OF LIMITING CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION/SUSTENANCE. ..COHEN/HART.. 07/15/2014

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MARGINALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON FROM THE FL PANHANDLE NEWD ACROSS GA INTO SC. DUE TO THE ISOLATED AND BRIEF NATURE OF THE THREAT...WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED ACROSS THE REGION THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A COLD FRONT MOVING SEWD INTO THE SRN APPALACHIAN MTNS AND TN VALLEY WITH A BROAD CORRIDOR OF VERY MOIST AIR LOCATED FROM THE GULF COAST STATES EXTENDING NEWD INTO THE CAROLINAS. MESOANALYSIS DATA INDICATES THAT MODERATE INSTABILITY IS ALREADY IN PLACE ALONG THIS CORRIDOR WITH MLCAPE ESTIMATED IN THE 1500 TO 2500 J/KG RANGE. ALTHOUGH DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS RELATIVELY WEAK...LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE BECOMING STEEP ACROSS PARTS OF GA AND SC. 0-3 KM LAPSE ARE ESTIMATED IN THE 7.5 TO 8.0 C/KM RANGE ACROSS MUCH OF THE MCD AREA. THIS SHOULD ENABLE THE STRONGER CELLS TO PRODUCE MARGINALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS. THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL LIKELY BE MAXIMIZED WITH SHORT LINE SEGMENTS THAT CAN PERSIST IN AREAS THAT DESTABILIZE THE MOST.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP FROM NE NC EXTENDING NEWD ACROSS THE MID-ATLANTIC TO THE VICINITY OF NEW YORK CITY THIS AFTERNOON. WIND DAMAGE AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. WW ISSUANCE APPEARS LIKELY ACROSS THE REGION WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A COLD FRONT IN THE SRN AND CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS WITH A PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH EXTENDING FROM SRN PA SWD INTO VA AND NRN NC. SFC DEWPOINTS ALONG THE TROUGH ARE IN THE UPPER 60S AND LOWER 70S F AND THIS HAS CONTRIBUTED TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF MODERATE INSTABILITY. RAP MESOANALYSIS DATA IS SUGGESTING THAT TWO POCKETS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY EXIST. THE FIRST IS LOCATED IN SRN NJ WITH THE SECOND OVER SERN VA AND NERN NC WHERE MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED IN THE 2000 TO 3500 J/KG RANGE. CONCERNING THE SHEAR ENVIRONMENT...WSR-88D VWPS FROM WASHINGTON DC NNEWD ALONG THE COAST TO NEAR NEWARK NJ SHOW UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES WITH 40 KT OF FLOW IN THE 3 TO 5 KM LAYER. THIS IS CREATING MODERATE DEEP LAYER SHEAR WHICH ALONG WITH THE INSTABILITY SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR ISOLATED SUPERCELLS AND ORGANIZED MULTICELLS. ANY SUPERCELL THAT CAN DEVELOP SHOULD HAVE POTENTIAL FOR WIND DAMAGE AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL. SHORT BOWING LINE SEGMENTS WILL ALSO HAVE A WIND DAMAGE THREAT. THE WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL COULD BECOME MORE SUBSTANTIAL IF CELLS CAN CONGEAL INTO A LARGER LINE SEGMENTS WITH A COLD POOL ORGANIZING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR AN ISOLATED SVR TSTM WILL EXIST THIS AFTERNOON...THOUGH WW ISSUANCE IS NOT NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WATER VAPOR LOOPS CONTINUE TO SHOW A COMPACT MID/UPPER VORT MAX PROGRESSING SEWD FROM THE NRN ROCKIES...NOW CENTERED NEAR GREAT FALLS MONTANA. LARGE-SCALE ASCENT PRECEDING THIS DISTURBANCE COUPLED WITH DIURNALLY STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES IN CLOUD-FREE AREAS TO ITS S...WHICH ARE INVIGORATING OROGRAPHIC CIRCULATIONS...IS SUPPORTING CONTINUED CUMULUS DEVELOPMENT AND ISOLATED TO SCATTERED STORMS. CONVECTION SHOULD CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THIS AFTERNOON. ONLY MODESTLY RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE -- E.G. SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MIDDLE 40S TO LOWER 50S -- WILL MARGINALIZE BUOYANCY. REGARDLESS...THE PRESENCE OF 500-1000 J/KG OF MLCAPE WILL LIKELY BE SUFFICIENT AMIDST A BAND OF ENHANCED WLYS TO THE S OF THE CYCLONE CENTER -- FAVORING 25-40 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR -- FOR ORGANIZED/SUSTAINED STORMS. AN ISOLATED STORM MAY PRODUCE SVR WIND/HAIL...THOUGH LIMITED BUOYANCY WILL LARGELY MITIGATE THE OVERALL SVR RISK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT SHOULD DEVELOP ACROSS SRN NEW ENGLAND OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL MAY OCCUR AS CELL COVERAGE INCREASES. WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED LATER THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A 1003 MB LOW OVER ONTARIO WITH A COLD FRONT EXTENDING SWD INTO THE UPPER OH VALLEY. A BROAD WARM SECTOR EXISTS EWD ACROSS THE CNTRL AND NRN APPALACHIAN MTNS WITH A CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ALONG THE MID-ATLANTIC COAST EXTENDING NEWD INTO SRN NEW ENGLAND. SFC DEWPOINTS ALONG THE MOIST AXIS ARE IN THE LOWER TO MID 70S F AND MLCAPE IS ESTIMATED TO BE FROM 1500 J/KG IN THE NEW YORK CITY AREA TO JUST ABOVE 500 J/KG IN SRN VT AND SRN NH. IN ADDITION...WSR-88D VWPS IN AND CLOSE TO THE MCD AREA SHOW UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES WITH 35 TO 40 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR. THIS SUGGESTS THAT SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT WILL BE POSSIBLE AS INSTABILITY INCREASES OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. SUPERCELLS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL. THE ENVIRONMENT SHOULD ALSO SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT OF PERSISTENT MULTICELL LINE SEGMENTS WITH A WIND DAMAGE THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE INCREASE IN THE SVR-TSTM POTENTIAL THIS AFTERNOON...AND THE ISSUANCE OF A WW IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VIS SATELLITE AND MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY INDICATE CONVECTION INCREASING IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY OVER THE ROCKIES. WITH THE CYS/FTG VWPS DEPICTING THE MID-LEVEL FLOW ORIENTED AT AN OBLIQUE ANGLE TO THE FRONT RANGE...CONVECTION MAY RESIDE MAINLY OVER THE MOUNTAINS DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. NEVERTHELESS...STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES COUPLED WITH INCREASING MID-LEVEL ASCENT/FLOW IN THE EXIT REGION OF A JET MAX APPROACHING FROM THE NW PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY...SUGGEST THAT ISOLATED STORMS MAY INTENSIFY TO MARGINALLY SVR LEVELS OVER THE MOUNTAINS IN THE SHORT-TERM. ALREADY AS OF EARLY AFTERNOON...THE CYS VWP SAMPLES 30-40 KT OF MID-LEVEL NWLYS PROVIDING SUFFICIENT DEEP SHEAR FOR STORM ORGANIZATION/SUSTENANCE. MEANWHILE...STATICALLY STABLE CONDITIONS LIKELY EXIST OVER THE ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS...PARTICULARLY WHERE LOW STRATUS HAS BEEN SLOWER TO ERODE. WAVE CLOUDS EVIDENT IN VIS IMAGERY NEAR/SE OF PUEBLO ILLUSTRATE THIS THERMODYNAMIC STABILITY. HOWEVER...WITH AT LEAST SOME CONVECTION-STEERING FLOW ORTHOGONAL TO THE FRONT RANGE...AND WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE MIDDLE 50S-AROUND 60F OVER THE HIGH PLAINS...STORMS COULD MOVE OFF THE MOUNTAINS AND ONTO THE PLAINS LATER THIS AFTERNOON AMIDST 1000-2000 J/KG OF MLCAPE. OTHER STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE PLAINS MAY EVOLVE ALONG A LEE TROUGH JUST E OF THE FRONT RANGE...AND ESPECIALLY NEAR A WEAK DENVER CYCLONE. LONG...NEARLY STRAIGHT-LINE HODOGRAPHS MAY INITIALLY SUPPORT SPLITTING STORMS WITH SVR HAIL...AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO -- AIDED BY LOW-LEVEL DIRECTIONAL SHEAR. HOWEVER...LOW-LEVEL FLOW WILL BE WEAK AND LIMIT THE OVERALL TORNADO RISK...WHILE AT LEAST SOME MLCINH POTENTIALLY PERSISTS. STORMS MAY EVENTUALLY CONSOLIDATE INTO FORWARD-PROPAGATING CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS WITH ISOLATED SVR WINDS BY LATE AFTERNOON. WITH STRONGER DEEP-LAYER ASCENT REL

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SVR THUNDERSTORM OR TWO MAY OCCUR THIS AFTERNOON...THOUGH WW ISSUANCE IS NOT NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WITH STEEP LAPSE RATES ALOFT ACCOMPANYING THE RESIDUAL MIXED LAYER SAMPLED BY THE 12Z GRAND JUNCTION COLORADO RAOB -- E.G. H7-H5 LAPSE RATE AROUND 8 C/KM -- COUPLING OF THE SFC LAYER TO THE OVERLYING MIXED LAYER IS FOSTERING SBCAPE AROUND 500-1000 J/KG. THIS IS BEING AIDED BY RESIDUAL MONSOONAL MOISTURE ACROSS THE REGION...WITH SFC OBSERVATIONS INDICATING DEWPOINTS GENERALLY IN THE 40S. MEANWHILE...TERRAIN-DRIVEN ASCENT IS ENHANCING DEEP CONVECTION OVER THE MOUNTAINS...AND FURTHER INCREASES IN STORM COVERAGE AND INTENSITY ARE EXPECTED AS WEAK MID-LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS/ASCENT GLANCE THE REGION WITH ADDITIONAL DIURNAL HEATING. VIS IMAGERY SUGGESTS THAT ANVILS ARE RESPONDING TO STRENGTHENING HIGH-LEVEL FLOW...AS THEY ARE BEING DEFINITIVELY SHED SEWD. THIS FLOW WILL CONTRIBUTE TO EFFICIENT CONVECTIVE VENTILATION AND MODEST EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR MAGNITUDES -- E.G. AROUND 20-25 KT -- TO SUPPORT STORM SUSTENANCE/ORGANIZATION. HOWEVER...MORE SUBSTANTIAL DEEP SHEAR SHOULD REMAIN ACROSS LOCATIONS FARTHER E/NE -- AS ADDRESSED IN MCD 1391. REGARDLESS...AN ISOLATED INSTANCE OR TWO OF SVR WIND/HAIL CANNOT BE RULED OUT ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA. THE LACK OF MORE SUBSTANTIAL BUOYANCY...AND THE LACK OF STRONGER LOW/MID-LEVEL FLOW...SHOULD PREVENT A MORE SUBSTANTIAL SVR RISK FROM OCCURRING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT IS LIKELY TO CONTINUE THROUGH EARLY EVENING ACROSS WW 423. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A NEARLY CONTINUOUS LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS IS CURRENTLY ONGOING FROM NEAR PHILADELPHIA PA SSWWD TO NEAR RICHMOND VA. THIS LINE IS LOCATED TO THE WEST OF AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY NEAR THE COAST WHERE MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED FROM 1500 TO 2500 J/KG. THE INSTABILITY SHOULD HELP THE LINE TO CONTINUE ORGANIZING AS IT MOVES TOWARD THE COAST. IN ADDITION...THE PHILADELPHIA WSR-88D VWP SHOWS UNIDIRECTIONAL WINDS WITH 30 TO 40 KT OF FLOW ABOVE 3 KM. THE WIND PROFILE COMBINED WITH STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ALONG THE INSTABILITY AXIS SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR A WIND DAMAGE THREAT LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY EVENING. THE WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL SHOULD BE GREATEST WITH SHORT BOWING LINE SEGMENTS EMBEDDED IN THE LINE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SVR WIND GUST OR TWO MAY AFFECT PORTIONS OF S-CNTRL AZ THIS AFTERNOON...THOUGH WW ISSUANCE WILL NOT BE NECESSARY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM MORNING CONVECTION THAT CONSOLIDATED IN THE TUCSON AREA IS SPREADING WWD OVER THE LOWER DESERTS OF SRN AZ. STORMS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ALONG THIS BOUNDARY AS IT ENCOUNTERS A DEEPLY MIXED PBL IN WHICH EARLIER INTRUSIONS OF MOISTURE FROM THE GULF OF CALIFORNIA ARE SUPPORTING DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 50S TO AROUND 60F -- YIELDING OF 500-1000 J/KG OF SBCAPE. ASCENT INVOF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY MAY CONTINUE TO FOCUS STORM DEVELOPMENT WWD ACROSS S-CNTRL AZ...WHILE ADDITIONAL TERRAIN-ENHANCED ASCENT ALONG THE MOGOLLON RIM PROMOTES STORM DEVELOPMENT WITH COLD POOLS DESCENDING TO THE LOWER DESERTS. WITH THE INCREASING CONVECTION OCCURRING AMIDST DCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG...STRONG DOWNDRAFTS CAPABLE OF AN ISOLATED INSTANCE OR TWO OF SVR WIND GUSTS MAY OCCUR -- ESPECIALLY WHERE COLD POOLS CONSOLIDATE. BLOWING DUST AND SUBSTANTIALLY REDUCED VISIBILITIES MAY ALSO ACCOMPANY SUCH ACTIVITY. CURRENT TRENDS SUGGEST THAT SUCH ACTIVITY COULD AFFECT PORTIONS OF THE GREATER PHOENIX AREA IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS OR SO.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A COUPLE OF SUPERCELLS CENTERED OVER PARTS OF S FRANKLIN COUNTY WILL POSE A PRIMARY RISK OF ISOLATED SEVERE WIND/HAIL AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. LONGEVITY OF THE RISK FOR GREATER SPATIOTEMPORAL DURATION RENDERS UNCERTAINTY IN WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A PAIR OF SUPERCELLS WITHIN AN EMBEDDED CONVECTIVE CLUSTER HAVE DEVELOPED NEAR THE FRANKLIN/OXFORD COUNTY LINE. 0-3 KM SRH IN GYX VWP DATA WAS ONLY AROUND 100-125 M2/S2...SUGGESTING THAT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES MAY ONLY BE TRANSIENT IN NATURE. ALONG WITH PROBABLE INFLOW INGESTION OF OVERTURNED AIR FROM A SHORT QLCS ALONG THE SW ME/NH COAST AND COASTAL MARINE LAYER...THE LONGEVITY OF AN ORGANIZED SEVERE RISK IS QUESTIONABLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: RISK FOR ISOLATED STRONG WINDS PRODUCING TREE DAMAGE SHOULD DIMINISH AFTER 00Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONSOLIDATION OF UPDRAFTS HAVE YIELDED TSTM CLUSTERS OVER THE RDU METRO AREA SW TOWARDS THE NC/SC BORDER AREA JUST SE OF CLT. BRIEFLY BULGING REFLECTIVITY STRUCTURES WILL REMAIN CAPABLE OF ISOLATED STRONG WINDS PRODUCING TREE DAMAGE DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. BUT WITH 0-6 KM SHEAR OF ONLY AROUND 15-25 KT PER GSP/CAE/AKQ VWP DATA AND PROBABLE STABILIZATION OVER MUCH OF THE COASTAL PLAIN AMIDST ABUNDANT STRATIFORM RAIN/CLOUDINESS....SPATIOTEMPORAL NATURE OF THIS RISK APPEARS LIMITED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS APPEARS TO BE DIMINISHING AND MUCH OF REMAINING PORTION OF WW 423 MAY BE LOCALLY CANCELLED PRIOR TO 01Z SCHEDULED EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LOW/MID-LEVEL REFLECTIVITY HAS WEAKENED SUBSTANTIALLY ACROSS MUCH OF THE WW 423...EXCEPT FOR TWO AREAS. ONE IS ALONG THE IMMEDIATE NJ COAST TO LONG ISLAND WHERE A WEAK SUPERCELL STRUCTURE IS EVIDENT JUST S OF NASSAU COUNTY. ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND EVEN A WATERSPOUT OR BRIEF TORNADO WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR SO AMIDST 0-1 KM SHEAR OF 20-25 KT PER OKX VWP DATA. THE SECOND CORRIDOR OF LOCALIZED DAMAGING WIND RISK IS BACK TOWARDS THE DC METRO AREA WHERE A CLUSTER OF TSTMS FORMED WITHIN A POCKET OF GREATER SURFACE HEATING IN THE WAKE OF THE EARLIER AFTERNOON CONVECTION. THIS CORRIDOR SHOULD BE LIMITED IN SPATIOTEMPORAL EXTENT GIVEN COOLER/STABILIZED AIR MASS HOLDING FROM THE CHESAPEAKE BAY/LOWER POTOMAC REGION AMIDST CONTINUED STRATIFORM RAIN. ..GRAMS.. 07/15/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SVR TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST AS THEY CONTINUE SEWD ACROSS SE WY AND INTO THE FAR WRN NEB PANHANDLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ACROSS SE WY AND THE FAR WRN NEB PANHANDLE. A WATCH ISSUANCE WILL BE COORDINATED BETWEEN THE SPC AND THE AFFECTED LOCAL NATIONAL WEATHER SERVICE OFFICES SHORTLY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MARGINAL/LOCALIZED SEVERE HAIL/WIND RISK MAY PERSIST FOR A FEW MORE HOURS...BUT SHOULD CONTINUE TO DIMINISH. ADDITIONAL DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTM CLUSTERS OVER SE WY HAVE WEAKENED OVERALL DURING THE PAST COUPLE OF HOURS. AS THIS ACTIVITY CONTINUES TO OVERSPREAD A PROGRESSIVELY COOLER RESIDUAL BOUNDARY LAYER IN NE CO AND W NEB...APPRECIABLE INTENSITY INCREASE IS NOT ANTICIPATED. STILL..THIS CONVECTION REMAINS IN A FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR POTENTIAL UPDRAFT ROTATION...WITH 0-6 KM SHEAR NEAR 50 KT PER CYS/FTG VWP DATA. THIS COULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR A BRIEF FLARE-UP OF MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL/WIND...BUT CONTINUED WANING INSTABILITY SUGGEST THE OVERALL RISK IS LOW. ..GRAMS.. 07/16/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
